about_the_game:
<Ancient Style Girl Dynamic Jigsaw Puzzle> is a dynamic jigsaw puzzle game. Every girl wants to show herself to the fullest and interact with you in her own world. Come and piece them together to interact with her!

Trial Version Instructions:

The trial version only includes 6 animated images, while the full version will contain 36 animated images.

Gameplay:

■ Mouse operation

■ Click on the fragment, drag the fragment and exchange positions with other fragments

■ Click on the picture icon to temporarily view the complete picture

■ After piecing together all the fragments into a complete picture, you can unlock the Girl's Guide

Game features:

■ Dynamic Images

■ The program automatically segments the pictures

■ The dynamic movements of the girls interact with you

■ Achievement System

■ Selectable custom game difficulty

■ 36 beautiful girls are waiting to be unlocked

content_descriptors.notes: The girl in the game is dressed rather sexily and will perform sexy action dances
